updates.text: Harris retained the corrected rub path with contact. His timing and help responsibilities still belong to the particular coverage call, not a general claim of matchup superiority.
updates.source: Source: [dated camp observations](career/2014/Training_Camp_and_Preseason/Training_Camp/training_report.md). This coaching update preserves the opening grades above.

updates.text: Seventy defensive snaps at the starting cornerback opposite Talib with six tackles, the last the third-and-8 stop of Foles's scramble that ended Philadelphia's first overtime possession; the play-by-play records no throw completed over him and no coverage on the four long completions, so the film holds that question. A long-term lower-extremity injury was logged at the end of that possession and he was removed: out, projected return in 92 days (December 8), reassessment September 14 ([medical record](career/2014/Team_Operations/Medical/incidents/mike_harris_2014-09-07.md)). His roster disposition is Caldwell's with the user and the Week 2 place is Stone's after the September 8 review; nothing is decided by the injury.
updates.source: Source: [Week 1 game record](career/2014/Regular_Season/Games/Week_01/output.md) and its public receipt. This coaching update preserves the opening grades above.

updates.text: Examined Monday with the September 7 instruction unchanged (out, long term; projected return December 8); placed on ordinary reserve/injured by Caldwell on Stone's recommendation, the club's one return designation going to Lowery. His 2014 season with the club is over and his contract continues. No football finding attaches to the injury; the Week 1 question on the four long completions stays with the film.
updates.source: Source: [September 8 transactions](career/2014/Team_Operations/Team/Roster/transactions_2014-09-08.md) and the [medical history](career/2014/Team_Operations/Medical/medical_history.md#september-8-to-12-jones-drew-reassessed-and-cleared-harris-and-lowery-to-reserveinjured). This coaching update preserves the opening grades above.

short.text: The staff sees Mike Harris as a replacement starter or reserve corner for a defined outside role, and he has filled one for Jacksonville: he took over for the injured Alan Ball in 2013 on a week's preparation, kept the job through both playoff games and started the 2014 opener at Philadelphia opposite Aqib Talib. He dressed for all {{2013.regular.games}} regular-season games in 2013, and an injury in the 2014 opener ended his season. He has usable movement without a defining edge in press coverage, ball skills or play at the catch point, and his route recognition is a limitation.

transactions.text: Signed a four-year rookie contract with Jacksonville
